```{r}
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges)

# Load the tab file (cols: 1=chr, 2=start, 3=end, 5=strand, 6=meta)
dt <- fread("/Users/mikej/Documents/Career/Georges/Ule/intron_retention_propensity/data/IR/braunschweigintrons_hg38.bed")
setnames(dt, c("chr","start","end","meta","v5","strand"))
dt[, chr := sub("^chr", "", chr)]
dt[, meta_last := sub(".*:([^:]+)$", "\\1", meta)]

gr_introns <- GRanges(
  seqnames = dt$chr,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = dt$start, end = dt$end),
  strand   = dt$strand
)

# Carry metadata
mcols(gr_introns) <- dt

# Nearest mapping from gr_meta -> gr_introns
nearest_hits <- nearest(gr_meta, gr_introns, ignore.strand = FALSE)

# Merge: keep all gr_meta metadata + the parsed meta_last from introns
mergedAnno <- cbind(
  mcols(gr_meta),
  br_meta = mcols(gr_introns)$meta_last[nearest_hits]
)

mergedAnno_dt <- as.data.table(mergedAnno)
mergedAnno_dt <- mergedAnno_dt[, c(2, 156), with = FALSE]

annotation_row <- as.data.table(annotation_row, keep.rownames = "EVENT")
res_full <- merge(annotation_row, mergedAnno_dt, by = "EVENT", all = TRUE)

# add rownames as a new column called EVENT
#annotation_row[, EVENT := rownames(annotation_row)]

# Looks good on merge agreement

res_full$IntronType <- NULL
colnames(res_full)[colnames(res_full) == "br_meta"] <- "IntronType"

# Label filtered introns as cluster 5 and order rows by Cluster
levels(res_full$Cluster) <- c(levels(res_full$Cluster), "Cluster_5")
res_full$Cluster[is.na(res_full$Cluster)] <- "Cluster_5"
sum(res_full$Cluster == "Cluster_5", na.rm = TRUE)
res_full <- res_full[order(res_full$Cluster), , drop = FALSE]

# add rownames, drop rows that aren't in main data table and count, drop event column and save
rownames(res_full) <- res_full$EVENT
res_full <- res_full[rownames(res_full) %in% rownames(mergedCleanedData), ]
sum(!rownames(res_full) %in% rownames(mergedCleanedData))
res_full$EVENT <- NULL
saveRDS(res_full, "annotation_rowtype12082025.rds")
```
